name: Glare Hover
description: Wrapper that sweeps a light glare band across its children on hover, click, focus, on a timed loop, or following the cursor, with an optional glint along the border rim.
contents: Inline-grid wrapper box that renders any children
Overlay glare band with gradient profile and blend mode
Optional rim glint masked to the 1px border edge
behavior: hover mode sweeps the glare across on pointer enter and sweeps it out on leave
click mode sweeps on pointer down
loop mode sweeps automatically every interval seconds while visible
follow mode shows a spring-driven glare tracking the pointer and fades on leave
Keyboard focus-visible triggers a sweep in non-follow modes
intro sweeps once when the element is 40 percent visible
Sweep is skipped and follow glare hidden when the user prefers reduced motion
editableByProps: Size, background, border color and radius
Glare color, opacity, angle, band size, softness and blend mode
Trigger mode, sweep duration, loop interval, play once and intro sweep
Rim glint on or off, extra className and inline style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the spring feel of follow mode
needsCodeEdit.where: The 170 and 24 constants in the frame function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how much of the element must be visible for loop and intro

fixed: Root is an inline-grid with overflow hidden and a 1px solid border, so content is clipped to the box
Glare overlay ignores pointer events and is hidden from assistive tech
Uses color-mix in gradients, which needs a modern browser
Changing mode re-creates all listeners, observers and timers
Hover and follow modes rely on pointer events, touch devices only get the sweep on tap through pointer enter or click mode
Loop and intro only run while at least 40 percent of the element is in view
Works at any size, the glare scales with the element, but width and height must fit the layout since defaults are auto

options.look: Single focused light streak with a faint wide wash
options.useWhen: Classic shine over cards or buttons on a pricing or feature grid

options.look: Wide soft band followed by a thin sharp line, like glass reflection
options.useWhen: Premium glass or metallic card, such as a credit card or product tile

options.look: Broad subtle sheen with no hard edge
options.useWhen: Large hero image or panel needing a gentle ambient highlight
